31103-a-christmas-greeting-a-series-of-s.title: A Christmas Greeting A Series Of Stories
31103-a-christmas-greeting-a-series-of-s.creator: Unknown
31103-a-christmas-greeting-a-series-of-s.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Whilst occupied with a greater work, there sprung forth--as the flowers spring forth in the forest--seven short stories.* I feel a desire, a longing, to transplant in England the first produce of my poetic garden, as a Christmas greeting: and I send it to you, my dear, noble, Charles Dickens, who by your works had been previously dear to me, and since our meeting have taken root for ever in my heart.

arxiv-1904-11898.title: Perceptual Attention-based Predictive Control
arxiv-1904-11898.creator: Keuntaek Lee, Gabriel Nakajima An, Viacheslav Zakharov, Evangelos A. Theodorou
arxiv-1904-11898.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a novel information processing architecture for safe deep learning-based visual navigation of autonomous systems. The proposed information processing architecture is used to support a perceptual attention-based predictive control algorithm that leverages model predictive control (MPC), convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and uncertainty quantification methods.

arxiv-2203-10562.title: CRISPnet: Color Rendition ISP Net
arxiv-2203-10562.creator: Matheus Souza, Wolfgang Heidrich
arxiv-2203-10562.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matheus Souza, Wolfgang Heidrich. Image signal processors (ISPs) are historically grown legacy software systems for reconstructing color images from noisy raw sensor measurements. They are usually composited of many heuristic blocks for denoising, demosaicking, and color restoration. Color reproduction in this context is of particular importance, since the raw colors are often severely distorted, and each smart phone manufacturer has developed their own characteristic heuristics for improving the color rendition, for example of skin tones and other visually important colors.

arxiv-2301-03208.title: Symmetry classes of dissipative topological insulators with edge dark state
arxiv-2301-03208.creator: Fei Yang, Zheng Wei, Xianqi Tong, Kui Cao, Su-Peng Kou
arxiv-2301-03208.description: Abstract We classify the dissipative topological insulators (TIs) with edge dark states (EDS) by using the 38-fold way of non-Hermitian systems in this paper. The dissipative dynamics of these quadratic open fermionic systems is captured by a non-Hermitian single-particle matrix which contains both the internal dynamics and the dissipation, refereed to as damping matrix X X .

arxiv-2303-14291.title: Applications of Gaussian Processes at Extreme Lengthscales: From Molecules to Black Holes
arxiv-2303-14291.creator: Ryan-Rhys Griffiths
arxiv-2303-14291.description: Abstract In many areas of the observational and experimental sciences data is scarce. Observation in high-energy astrophysics is disrupted by celestial occlusions and limited telescope time while laboratory experiments in synthetic chemistry and materials science are both time and cost-intensive.

arxiv-2406-14587.title: A COUNTEREXAMPLE TO CONJECTURE “CATCH 22”
arxiv-2406-14587.creator: Bogdan Butyrin
arxiv-2406-14587.description: Abstract Abstract: We construct a finite deterministic graphical (DG) game without Nash equilibria in pure stationary strategies. This game has 3 players I=\{1,2,3\} and 5 outcomes: 2 terminal a_{1} and a_{2} and 3 cyclic. Furthermore, for 2 players a terminal outcome is the best: a_{1} for player 3 and a_{2} for player 1.

arxiv-2409-02473.title: A Variable Power Surface Error Function backstepping based Dynamic Surface Control of Non-Lower Triangular Nonlinear Systems
arxiv-2409-02473.creator: Abdulrazaq Nafiu Abubakar, Ali Nasir*, Md Muzakkir Quamar
arxiv-2409-02473.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Abdulrazaq Nafiu Abubakar, Ali Nasir*, Md Muzakkir Quamar. A control design for error reduction in the tracking control for a class of non-lower triangular nonlinear systems is presented by combining techniques of Variable Power Surface Error Function (VPSEF), backstepping, and dynamic surface control. At each step of design, a surface error is obtained, and based on its magnitude, the VPSEF technique decides the surface error to be used. Thus, the backstepping-based virtual and actual control law is designed to stabilize the corresponding subsystem.

arxiv-2410-14964.title: ChronoFact: Timeline-based Temporal Fact Verification
arxiv-2410-14964.creator: Anab Maulana Barik, Wynne Hsu, Mong Li Lee
arxiv-2410-14964.description: Abstract Temporal claims, often riddled with inaccuracies, are a significant challenge in the digital misinformation landscape. Fact-checking systems that can accurately verify such claims are crucial for combating misinformation. Current systems struggle with the complexities of evaluating the accuracy of these claims, especially when they include multiple, overlapping, or recurring events.

arxiv-2505-13441.title: GraspMolmo: Generalizable Task-Oriented Grasping via Large-Scale Synthetic Data Generation
arxiv-2505-13441.creator: Abhay Deshpande, Yuquan Deng, Arijit Ray, Jordi Salvador, Winson Han, Jiafei Duan, Kuo-Hao Zeng, Yuke Zhu, Ranjay Krishna, Rose Hendrix
arxiv-2505-13441.description: Abstract We present GraspMolmo , a generalizable open-vocabulary task-oriented grasping (TOG) model. GraspMolmo predicts semantically appropriate, stable grasps conditioned on a natural language instruction and a single RGB-D frame. For instance, given “pour me some tea,” GraspMolmo selects a grasp on a teapot handle rather than its body.

Human neural stem cells (hNSC) represent an essential source of renewable brain cells for both experimental studies and cell replacement therapies. pmc-10537075.title: MRI-based machine learning models predict the malignant biological behavior of meningioma
pmc-10537075.creator: Maoyuan Li, Luzhou Liu, Jie Qi, Ying Qiao, Hanrui Zeng, Wen Jiang, Rui Zhu, Fujian Chen, Huan Huang, Shaoping Wu
pmc-10537075.description: BackgroundThe WHO grade and Ki-67 index are independent indices used to evaluate the malignant biological behavior of meningioma. This study aims to develop MRI-based machine learning models to predict the malignant biological behavior of meningioma from the perspective of the WHO grade, Ki-67 index, and their combination.

pmc-11506746.title: Progression in Near-Infrared Fluorescence Imaging Technology for Lung Cancer Management
pmc-11506746.creator: Xinglong Chen, Yuning Li, Jialin Su, Lemeng Zhang, Hongwen Liu
pmc-11506746.description: Lung cancer is a major threat to human health and a leading cause of death. Accurate localization of tumors in vivo is crucial for subsequent treatment. In recent years, fluorescent imaging technology has become a focal point in tumor diagnosis and treatment due to its high sensitivity, strong selectivity, non-invasiveness, and multifunctionality.

pmc-11780373.title: Editors' introduction: The microenvironment in bone metastasis – New dimensions
pmc-11780373.creator: Ingunn Holen, Claire Edwards
pmc-11780373.description: that have expanded our understanding of tumour-bone crosstalk over the subsequent eight years. There is now a greater appreciation of the contribution of different cell types including adipocytes and macrophages [1], [2], as well as an increased understanding of the multiple roles of classical bone cells and niches, including the dormant niche [3], [4], [5], [6].

pmc-12421914.title: NFE2 and PF4 as biomarkers for BET inhibition-induced thrombocytopenia in preclinical and clinical studies
pmc-12421914.creator: Cindy Zhang, Ke Xu, Faye Wang, Jennifer Price, Julie Panzica, Shodeinde Coker, Oriana Esposito, Danielle Greenawalt, Richard Westhouse, Karen Augustine-Rauch
pmc-12421914.description: IntroductionBromodomain and Extraterminal (BET) proteins play a crucial role in cellular proliferation and differentiation through the epigenetic regulation of gene transcription. As a result, inhibiting BET family proteins emerges as a promising epigenetic approach for treating various cancers. However, clinical trials have indicated that thrombocytopenia is a dose-limiting toxicity associated with BET inhibition.

pmc-12448814.title: Mixing varieties mitigates early root competition in wheat under water and nutrient limitation
pmc-12448814.creator: Germain Montazeaud, Pierre Roumet, Mickaël Lamboeuf, Christian Jeudy, Martin Ecarnot, Lise Malicet-Chebbah, Christophe Salon, Hélène Fréville, Susanne Dreisigacker
pmc-12448814.description: Competition between plants can lead to a tragedy of the commons (TOC), where excessive investment in resource-harvesting organs reduces collective performance. Mixing crop varieties could resolve such TOCs through niche complementarity—if varieties differ in resource use—or selection effects, where competitive varieties benefit from weaker neighbours. While most studies on varietal mixtures focus on above-ground traits, below-ground interactions remain poorly understood.

pmc-12492897.title: Cryo-EM studies of amyloid-β fibrils from human and murine brains carrying the Uppsala APP mutation (Δ690–695)
pmc-12492897.creator: Mara Zielinski, Fernanda S Peralta Reyes, Lothar Gremer, Simon Sommerhage, María Pagnon de la Vega, Christine Röder, Thomas V Heidler, Stina Syvänen, Dieter Willbold, Dag Sehlin, Martin Ingelsson, Gunnar F Schröder
pmc-12492897.description: Today, 13 intra-amyloid-β (Aβ) amyloid precursor protein (APP) gene mutations are known to cause familial Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Most of them are point mutations causing an increased production or a change in the conformation of Aβ. The Uppsala APP mutation (Δ690–695 in APP, Δ19–24 in Aβ) is the first known multi-codon deletion causing autosomal dominant AD.

pmc-12509902.title: PRMT1/PRMT5-Mediated Differential Arginine Methylation of CRIP1 Promotes the Recurrence of Small Cell Lung Cancer after Chemotherapy
pmc-12509902.creator: Yu Han, Lie Ma, Xiaolei Zhang, Qingyuan Ren, Qingxia Yuan, Jiawen Zhou, Yanjing Ren, Na Wan, Xin Jin, Jingyao Hou, Yanbo Wang, Baiqu Huang, Yu Zhang, Jun Lu
pmc-12509902.description: Arginine methylation, a critical epigenetic modification, plays a vital role in tumor initiation and progression; however, the mechanism by which arginine methylation regulates tumor recurrence remains unclear. Here, we found the differential changes between arginine methyltransferase PRMT1 and PRMT5 in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) cells after cisplatin and etoposide treatment.

pmc-12737101.title: Senna petersiana (Bolle) Lock: A Review of Its Ethnomedicinal Uses, Phytochemistry, Pharmacological Activities, and Toxicological Profile
pmc-12737101.creator: Talita Jessica Mnisi, Mashilo Mash Matotoka, Peter Masoko, Gang Ding, Nkoana Mongalo
pmc-12737101.description: Senna petersiana (Bolle) Lock is a chemically diverse plant widely recognized for its ethnomedicinal applications across various traditional medical systems. It is native to and widely distributed in African countries, including Ethiopia, Cameroon, and South Africa. This review integrates the phytochemical composition, biological activities, and toxicological effects of S. petersiana.

pmc-13016777.title: Parallel Mechanisms for Re-Epithelialization Following Skin Cell Suspension Autograft Application: Scientific Insights into Acute Wound Healing
pmc-13016777.creator: Katie A Bush, Elisa N Stephens, Ghaidaa Kashgari, Aleisha K Chamberlain, Steven A Kahn
pmc-13016777.description: Timely closure of acute, full-thickness wounds is critical in minimizing complications such as infection, fluid loss, and impaired healing, all of which can adversely affect long-term patient outcomes. Although meshed autografting is the current standard of care, its effectiveness is limited by the need for donor skin and the re-epithelialization of expanded interstices.

pmc-13212704.title: Failure of MMA embolization due to deep and middle temporal artery supply in chronic subdural hematoma: the diagnostic value of 3D-RA
pmc-13212704.creator: Masaomi Takeuchi, Yoichi Morofuji, Yuki Matsunaga, Chieko Inoue, Eri Shiozaki, Takayuki Matsuo
pmc-13212704.description: Chronic subdural hematoma (CSDH) is commonly managed with burr hole evacuation, yet recurrence remains frequent. Middle meningeal artery (MMA) embolization has emerged as a minimally invasive treatment. We describe the case of an 85-year-old man with refractory CSDH who developed multiple recurrences despite repeated surgical evacuation and MMA embolization.

pmc-13320236.title: Cholecalciferol and muscle strength in hemodialysis patients: results from the randomized VITADIAL trial
pmc-13320236.creator: Stanislas Bataille, Guillaume Seret, Frederic Lavainne, Philippe Giaime, Marianne Serveaux, Thomas Robert, Mickael Bobot, Laurence Vrigneaud, Guillaume Jean, Louis De Laforcade, Mathilde Prezelin-Reydit, Philippe Chauveau, Myriam Isnard, Laurent Samson, Angélique Colin, Frederique Boury, Axel Viton,
pmc-13320236.description: BackgroundMany factors contribute to muscle impairment during chronic kidney disease, among which vitamin D deficiency has been implicated. The aim of this study was to analyze whether cholecalciferol supplementation in hemodialysis patients with low 25-hydroxyvitamin vitamin D (25OHD) concentrations could improve handgrip strength (HGS).MethodsVITADIAL (Does Correction of 25 OH-VITAmin D With Cholecalciferol Supplementation Increase Muscle Strength in HemoDIALysis Patients?

pmc-13668882.title: Selection and evaluation of reference genes for RT-qPCR normalization across developmental stages and tissues in Dermestes maculatus (Coleoptera: Dermestidae)
pmc-13668882.creator: Lele Tian, Yang Xia, Guojing Xu, Yinghao Zhai, Yanjie Shang, Yadong Guo
pmc-13668882.description: Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) is widely used for gene expression quantification, and stably expressed reference genes are essential for accurate data normalization. However, validated reference genes are not yet available for the hide beetle, Dermestes maculatus De Geer, 1774 (Coleoptera: Dermestidae), an economically important stored-product pest and a forensically relevant necrophagous beetle.
